_about: Ernest Hemingway, The Sun Also Rises (1926). US public domain since 2022; Hemingway died 1961, so UK copyright runs to 2031. Added from the classical reading lists (Classical Conversations, Canon Press, New Saint Andrews, Logos School/Online, Bethlehem College & Seminary, Memoria Press, CiRCE): docs/reading-lists/READING-LISTS.tsv. Bloom addition 2026-11-03 (Bloom's Western Canon): hemingway-our-time, hemingway-men-without-women.

hemingway-our-time.evidence: djvu grep: copyright line and 'Indian Camp' read; BYU copy, americana
hemingway-our-time.case: Bloom lists Hemingway's Complete Short Stories (1987, not PD). The two pre-1931 collections -- In Our Time (1925) and Men Without Women (1927) -- are PD and hold many of his best stories.
hemingway-our-time.note: PARTIAL. Held already: The Sun Also Rises, A Farewell to Arms (hemingway shelf, relay). PG 61085 is the 1924 Paris 'in our time' vignettes only, not the 1925 story collection. The 1925 IA scan's first page is noisy OCR but the text from 'Indian Camp' on reads cleanly. PG 59603 Three Stories & Ten Poems (1923) also PD.
